title: 第六章：这是，真实的世界
content_zh:
之前得到【破旧的燧发枪】时，苏晓得到了许多提示，
但他得到的这把匕首却没有任何提示，没有具体的资料，也没显示是否能出售。
这让苏晓猜测，之前他得到那把【破旧的燧发枪】，既有运气成分，也可能是‘轮回乐园’故意安排。
意思是他可以得到武器，但却需要承担一些风险，这应该就是‘轮回乐园’的法则。
而他手中这把匕首，明显不在这个范畴内，匕首很锋利，他可以使用，但却不能带出海贼世界，也无法换取乐园币。
这也是理所应当的事，如果任何东西都能贩卖成乐园币，那‘轮回乐园’的货币机制，也只是一种笑话而已。
驱赶着那不太听话的马匹，苏晓逐渐靠近城门，那几名侍卫已经映入他视线内。
突然换了主人，这匹老马明显有些不听指挥，这让苏晓有些为难，他从没操纵过马匹，但侍卫就在眼前，已经容不得他退后。
一拽手中的鞍绳，那匹马打了个响鼻，停在原地。
苏晓主动停下来接受检查，根据他的猜测，出城时比较松懈，但入城绝没那么简单。
几名侍卫走上前来，看似神态懒散，可几双眼睛却有如鹰唳般锐利。
“怎么回事，今天这么早就回城了？”
侍卫这熟识的态度，让苏晓浑身汗毛竖起。
这些侍卫，可能知道那名黑市商人的身份，双方甚至可能有利益关系，事情有些难办。
“大人，今天刚出城，就是托比的势力抢了，呕~。”
苏晓的声音非常模糊，而且还夹带着阵阵干呕，他的声音和车夫不同，所以他故意如此。
配合他衣服上那污水的恶臭，那些侍卫并没怀疑，甚至还躲开苏晓一段距离。
“什么？托比？他们是在找死吗，连你都敢抢，难道他不知道你的身份？”
苏晓面前那名侍卫明显有些愤怒，但一旁另一侍卫说道：
“老大，托比那家伙最近势力扩张的很快，根据我的眼线，托比刚灭了罗吉尔的势力，现在除了布尔萨姆海贼团，废品终点站没有势力超越托比。”

“就这么算了？钱怎么办。”
几名侍卫对视一眼，眼中虽然都有不甘，但对于藏匿在废品终点站内的托比也没有办法。
“你……，算了，下次如果再有这种事，你也不用回来，就‘生活’在废品终点站吧。”
苏晓假装唯唯诺诺的点头，但眼中却非常冷静。
越是到了关键时刻，越要冷静，许多失败都发生在成功前的得意忘形。
苏晓驱赶马匹，那匹棕色老马有些不情愿的向前走去。
就在苏晓离开之前，一位侍卫俯身看了眼车底，以免有人藏在车底，这是流民混入城中常用的方法。
苏晓从没想过藏在车底，而直接做掉车夫，取而代之，这种方法虽然冒险，但却抓住了侍卫的监察盲区。
垃圾车逐渐穿过城门，平稳的向前驶去，三米、五米，十米，
“卡洛斯，等等。“
身后传来侍卫的喊声，苏晓瞳孔一阵紧缩，但马上恢复正常。
“你侄子的事，我已经安排好，带着足够的‘诚意’，今天就可以去侍卫队报道。”
侍卫单手高举，拇指和中指相互搓动，那所谓的‘诚意’，指的就是金钱。
苏晓连忙点头，作势要道谢，但却发出连连干呕。
“赶紧走，真是臭死了，离这么远我都能闻到。”
这种好机会苏晓当然不会错过，拿起一旁的马鞭，对着那匹老马的屁股就是一鞭。
“啪~。”
一声脆响传开，那匹老马哀鸣一声，脚步明显加快。
潜入成功了，苏晓安全的混入到哥亚王国的王都。
虽然他有更安全的方法潜入王都，但那需要时间，他现在的时间并不充裕。

而且从那些侍卫的只言片语中，他得到了许多有用的情报。
第一，现在的时间点是在原著主角蒙奇?d?路飞出海的之前，也就是路飞的幼年，或者路飞根本没有出生。
断定这一点的依据，是之前侍卫口中的布尔萨姆海贼团、
如果苏晓没记错，布尔萨姆海贼团，就是原著中和幼年路飞、艾斯等人在大火中交战海贼团。
布尔萨姆海贼团在原著中被哥亚王国的国王利用，亲手引燃了废品终点站，之后就被抛弃，任由其在大火中自生自灭。
而第二，是一个非常意外的收获，或许这个收获，就是苏晓任务成功的关键。
刚才侍卫的一句话，苏晓心中大喜，那就是‘你侄子的事，我已经安排好，带着足够的‘诚意’，今天就可以去侍卫队报道。’
看来这是那死去的黑市商人和看守侍卫做的某种交易，利用金钱购买侍卫队的一份差事。
如果苏晓冒充对方的侄子进入侍卫队，那就代表他距离刺杀目标更近了一步。
虽然这样做很冒险，但也是眼下最好的办******回乐园没给他安排身份，他只是外来的黑户。
苏晓驾驶着马车行进在哥亚王国王都的街道上，因为刚进入王都的外层，这里只是平民的住宅区。
平民区的街道还算整洁，街道两侧满是叫卖的小贩。
大群平民悠闲的穿行在街道上，让整座城市显的熙熙攘攘，但也有些平民面带愁苦，神色匆匆。
这些平民与墙外流民唯一的差别是，他们不会挨饿，但也挣扎在温饱的边缘。
海贼世界正值动乱的时代，这里充斥着战乱与四处流窜的海贼，所以平民的生活条件相对贫穷。
穿行在喧哗的街道上，苏晓恍如隔世，仿佛这里并不是任务世界，而是一个真实的世界，这里都是有血有人的人类，而不是所谓的npc。
从之前那些侍卫就能看出，对方的警惕性不低，如果不是苏晓准备周全，应变迅速，可能已经被识破。
在任务世界中，不要小看任何人，苏晓在心中暗自警惕。
不过现在首要的事，找个地方清洗身体，之前得到的【宝箱（白）】，也要开启，他要把一切能利用的资源使用。
只有lv.1的苏晓，在这lv.6，噩梦难度的世界中，实在是举步维艰。

(三七中文 et)
content_en:
When Su Xiao got the [Old Flintlock Gun] before, she got a lot of hints.
But the dagger he got had no hints, no specific information, and no indication of whether it could be sold.
This made Su Xiao guess that the [shabby flintlock gun] he obtained before was either due to luck or a deliberate arrangement by the 'Reincarnation Paradise'.
This means that he can get weapons, but he needs to take some risks. This should be the law of 'Reincarnation Paradise'.
The dagger in his hand obviously does not fall into this category. The dagger is very sharp and he can use it, but it cannot be taken out of the pirate world, nor can it be exchanged for paradise coins.
This is also a matter of course. If anything can be sold as paradise coins, then the currency mechanism of 'Reincarnation Paradise' is just a joke.
Driving the less obedient horses, Su Xiao gradually approached the city gate, and the guards came into his sight.
The owner suddenly changed, and the old horse obviously did not obey the command, which made Su Xiao a little embarrassed. He had never controlled a horse, but the guard was right in front of him and he could no longer tolerate him to step back.
Pulling the saddle rope in his hand, the horse snorted and stopped in place.
Su Xiao took the initiative to stop for inspection. According to his guess, he was relatively relaxed when leaving the city, but entering the city was by no means that simple.
Several guards came forward. They seemed to have lazy expressions, but their eyes were as sharp as eagles.
"What's going on? You came back to the city so early today?"
The familiar attitude of the guard made the hairs on Su Xiao's body stand up.
These guards may know the identity of the black marketeer, and the two parties may even have an interest relationship, making things a bit difficult to handle.
"Sir, as soon as we left the city today, Toby's forces robbed us, ugh~"
Su Xiao's voice was very vague, and it was also accompanied by bursts of retching. His voice was different from that of the coachman, so he did it on purpose.
Coupled with the stench of sewage on his clothes, the guards did not suspect it and even stayed away from Su Xiao for a while.
"What? Toby? Are they looking for death? They dare to rob you. Don't they know your identity?"
The guard in front of Su Xiao was obviously a little angry, but another guard on the side said:
"Boss, Toby's power has been expanding rapidly recently. According to my intelligence, Toby has just destroyed Rogier's power. Now, except for the Bursam Pirates, there is no power in Scrap Terminal that can surpass Toby."
"Just forget it? What to do with the money?"
Several guards looked at each other. Although they were unwilling to do so, they could not do anything about Toby who was hiding in the scrap terminal.
"You..., forget it, if this happens again next time, you don't have to come back, just 'live' at the scrap terminal."
Su Xiao pretended to nod submissively, but her eyes were very calm.
The closer the critical moment is, the more calm you must be. Many failures occur when you get carried away before success.
Su Xiao drove the horse, and the old brown horse walked forward reluctantly.
Just before Su Xiao left, a guard leaned over and looked under the car to avoid anyone hiding under the car. This was a common method used by refugees to sneak into the city.
Su Xiao never thought of hiding under the car, but directly killed the driver and replaced him. Although this method was risky, it captured the guard's blind spot in monitoring.
The garbage truck gradually passed through the city gate and drove forward smoothly, three meters, five meters, ten meters,
"Carlos, wait."
The guard's shout came from behind, and Su Xiao's pupils tightened for a while, but they immediately returned to normal.
"I have made arrangements for your nephew. With enough 'sincerity', you can report to the Guards today."
The guard raised one hand high and rubbed his thumb and middle finger together. The so-called 'sincerity' refers to money.
Su Xiao nodded quickly, pretending to say thank you, but she retched repeatedly.
"Go away now, it really stinks, I can smell it from so far away."
Of course Su Xiao would not miss this good opportunity, picked it up and put it asideHe whipped the old horse's riding crop into the buttocks.
"Pa~."
A crisp sound spread, and the old horse whined, and its pace increased significantly.
The infiltration was successful, and Su Xiao sneaked into the capital of Goa Kingdom safely.
Although he had a safer way to sneak into the capital, it would take time, and he didn't have enough time now.
And from the few words of those guards, he got a lot of useful information.
First, the current time point is before the original protagonist Monkey D. Luffy went to sea, that is, Luffy was a child, or Luffy was not born at all.
The basis for concluding this is the Bursam Pirates,
If Su Xiao remembers correctly, the Bursam Pirates are the pirates who fought with young Luffy, Ace and others in the fire in the original book.
In the original work, the Bursam Pirates were used by the King of Goa to set the Scrap Terminal on fire, and then were abandoned and left to fend for themselves in the fire.
The second is a very unexpected gain. Perhaps this gain is the key to the success of Su Xiao's mission.
Su Xiao was overjoyed by what the guard said just now, that is, 'I have arranged your nephew's matter, and with enough 'sincerity', I can report to the guard today. ’
It seemed that this was some kind of deal between the dead black marketeer and the guards, using money to buy a job with the guards.
If Su Xiao pretends to be the other party's nephew and joins the guards, it means that he is one step closer to the assassination target.
Although this is very risky, it is also the best solution at the moment. ****** He did not have an identity assigned to him when he returned to the paradise. He was just a gangster from outside.
Su Xiao drove a carriage on the streets of King Goa's capital. Because he had just entered the outer layer of the capital, it was only a residential area for civilians.
The streets in the civilian area are relatively clean, and both sides of the street are full of hawkers.
Large groups of civilians walked leisurely through the streets, making the whole city appear bustling, but some civilians also had sad faces and hurried expressions.
The only difference between these civilians and the refugees outside the wall is that they will not starve, but they are still struggling on the edge of food and clothing.
The world of pirates is in a turbulent era, full of wars and pirates running around, so the living conditions of civilians are relatively poor.
Walking through the noisy streets, Su Xiao felt like she was in another world, as if this was not a mission world, but a real world where there were all living humans, not so-called NPCs.
It can be seen from the previous guards that the other party's vigilance is not low. If Su Xiao had not been well prepared and quick to respond, he might have been seen through.
In the mission world, don't underestimate anyone, Su Xiao was secretly vigilant in her heart.
But the first thing now is to find a place to cleanse his body. The [Treasure Box (White)] he obtained before must also be opened. He must use all available resources.
Su Xiao, who is only at level 1, is really struggling in this level 6, nightmare difficulty world.
(Sanqi Chinese et)
